GPU, model-registry (MLflow), LLM (vLLM) and KubeRay blocks were skipped. runtime_env pip installs failed in both posts' configs because the uv-created venv has no pip; that is an environment artifact, so those configs were also deployed with runtime_env removed.

preference.reason: The two posts are close: each has one wrong, code-breaking claim and otherwise exact numbers. Y's bug is in an alpha custom-router snippet. X's bug is in the guide's own production path: the running example's config file fails to deploy and its language-change claim is false. Y also covers more internals and design reasoning (pluggable routing with RFC and benchmark, backpressure, stats patterns, observability) and draws on more non-official sources. X is tidier in structure and much stronger on KubeRay operations and the autoscaler control loop. Narrow preference for Y.
